why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Mine page Go to the Mine page by Offline Protocol , the starting point for the points campaign.
2 Step 2 : Download the Mine app Use the Download Mine button on the Mine page to get the app.
3 Step 3 : Join the mesh near other devices Let the app connect with devices around you. This link-up with nearby peers is how you take part in the mesh.
4 Step 4 : Do the daily missions Work through the missions the app sets each day.
5 Step 5 : Keep growing the network Points are earned as the network grows, so keep linking up and doing missions. Offline Protocol has not published a points formula or a claim date.
